requests.description: anonymize the images corresponding to the supplied list of image IDs (each paired with a list of DICOM tag translation). This route corresponds to repeated use of the route /images/{id}/anonymize.
requests.name: POST /anonymization/anonymize

requests.description: get a list of anonymization keys, each specifying how vital DICOM attributes have been anonymized for a particular image
requests.name: GET /anonymization/keys

requests.description: export all anonymization keys as a csv file
requests.name: GET /anonymization/keys/export/csv

requests.description: submit a query for anonymization keys
requests.name: POST /anonymization/keys/query

requests.description: delete an anonymization key that is no longer of interest
requests.name: DELETE /anonymization/keys/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: get the anonymization key with the supplied ID
requests.name: GET /anonymization/keys/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: get pointers to the images corresponding to the anonymization key with the supplied ID
requests.name: GET /anonymization/keys/{id}/keyvalues
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: list all supported anonymization options defining an anonymization profile
requests.name: GET /anonymization/options

requests.description: get a list of box connections
requests.name: GET /boxes

requests.description: connect to another box using a received URL. Used to connect to a public box.
requests.name: POST /boxes/connect

requests.description: create a new box connection where the supplied entity holds the remote box name. Used by publicly available boxes.
requests.name: POST /boxes/createconnection

requests.description: get incoming transactions (finished, currently receiving, waiting or failed)
requests.name: GET /boxes/incoming

requests.description: delete an incoming transaction. If a currently active transaction is deleted, a new transaction with the remainder of the images is created when receiving the next incoming image.
requests.name: DELETE /boxes/incoming/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: get the received images corresponding to the incoming transaction with the supplied ID
requests.name: GET /boxes/incoming/{id}/images
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: get outgoing transactions (finished, currently sending, waiting or failed)
requests.name: GET /boxes/outgoing

requests.description: delete an outgoing transaction. This will stop ongoing transactions.
requests.name: DELETE /boxes/outgoing/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: get the sent images corresponding to the outgoing transaction with the supplied ID
requests.name: GET /boxes/outgoing/{id}/images
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Delete the remote box with the supplied ID
requests.name: DELETE /boxes/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: send images corresponding to the supplied image ids to the remote box with the supplied ID
requests.name: POST /boxes/{id}/send
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a list of currently available destinations. Possible destinations are box - sending data to a remote box, and scu - sending data a receiving SCP.
requests.name: GET /destinations

requests.description: get a list of watch directories. Each watch directory and its sub-directories are watched for incoming DICOM files, which are read and imported into slicebox.
requests.name: GET /directorywatches

requests.description: add a new directory to watch for incoming DICOM files
requests.name: POST /directorywatches

requests.description: stop watching and remove the directory corresponding to the supplied ID
requests.name: DELETE /directorywatches/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Get a list of source to filter associations.
requests.name: GET /filtering/associations

requests.description: Inserts or updates a source <-> filter associations. If the specified Source already  has an association this is updated, otherwise a new is inserted.
requests.name: POST /filtering/associations

requests.description: remove the source <-> filter association corresponding to the supplied ID
requests.name: DELETE /filtering/associations/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: List defined filters
requests.name: GET /filtering/filters

requests.description: Inserts or updates a filter. If a filter with same name as supplied filter exists this filter is updated, otherwise a new filter is inserted.
requests.name: POST /filtering/filters

requests.description: remove the filter corresponding to the supplied ID
requests.name: DELETE /filtering/filters/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: List tagpaths for the selected filter
requests.name: GET /filtering/filters/{id}/tagpaths
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: add a tagpath to a filter
requests.name: POST /filtering/filters/{id}/tagpaths
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: remove the tagpath corresponding to the supplied ID
requests.name: DELETE /filtering/filters/{id}/tagpaths/{tagpathid}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: remove the forwarding rule corresponding to the supplied ID
requests.name: DELETE /forwarding/rule/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: get a list of all forwarding rules. A forwarding rule specifies the automatic forwarding of images from a source (SCP, BOX, etc.) to a destimation (BOX, SCU, etc.)
requests.name: GET /forwarding/rules

requests.description: add a new forwarding rule
requests.name: POST /forwarding/rules

requests.description: add a DICOM dataset to slicebox
requests.name: POST /images

requests.description: bulk delete a sequence of images according to the supplied image IDs. This is the same as a sequence of DELETE requests to /images/{id}
requests.name: POST /images/delete

requests.description: download the export set with the supplied export set ID as a zip archive
requests.name: GET /images/export

requests.description: create an export set, a group of image IDs of images to export. The export set will contain the selected images. The export set is available for download 12 hours before it is automatically deleted.
requests.name: POST /images/export

requests.description: add a JPEG image to slicebox. The image data will be wrapped in a DICOM file and added as a new series belonging to the study with the supplied ID
requests.name: POST /images/jpeg

requests.description: Delete the image with the supplied ID
requests.name: DELETE /images/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: fetch dataset corresponding to the supplied image ID
requests.name: GET /images/{id}
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: delete the selected image and replace it with an anonymized version
requests.name: PUT /images/{id}/anonymize
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: get an anonymized version of the image with the supplied ID
requests.name: POST /images/{id}/anonymized
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: list all DICOM attributes of the dataset corresponding to the supplied image ID
requests.name: GET /images/{id}/attributes
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: get basic information about the pixel data of an image
requests.name: GET /images/{id}/imageinformation
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: modify and/or insert image attributes according to the input tagpath-value mappings
requests.name: PUT /images/{id}/modify
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: get a PNG image representation of the image corresponding to the supplied ID
requests.name: GET /images/{id}/png
requests.note: Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Returns a list of available import sessions.
requests.name: GET /import/sessions

requests.description: create a new import sessions
requests.name: POST /import/sessions
